description:
Real-time fluid simulation (FluidNinja LIVE) on a 2D GPU grid: water (lakes, pools, seas) that ripples and wakes around
anything moving through it; fire (bonfire, campfire, candle, flamethrower), smoke (columns, heavy smoke, explosions),
fog / mist banks, mud and blood, snow and sand that keep tracks, drifting snow and sand, lava; plus flow sources (hoses,
jets, vortices, emitters) that push and feed simulations, and ambient particles (blizzard, sandstorm, rain, sparks).
Characters, vehicles and objects that generate overlap events disturb a simulation anywhere over its area (built
meshes do not by default); the fluid does not push objects back. Fog / mist turns on the level's volumetric fog.
Workflow: list (presets, effects, sources, ambient, what exists) -> add (a preset or effect at a place; size, yaw) ->
add_source to feed or stir it -> ambient for atmosphere -> screenshot -> remove. Pairs with sky.set_weather and
sky.set_ground.
name: fluid

tools.description:
Adds a fluid simulation from a preset: the simulation plus the water surface it drives. Undoable.
Returns: The new simulation. Fails if FluidNinja is not in the project, the preset or material is unknown, or a value is out of range.

follow_player.description: The simulation travels with the player's character (a beach, sea or sand area that is always around them, like the pack's coast demo); create the character first.

location.description: Centre of the area on the water level (cm), e.g. [0, 0, 20]. ([x, y, z] (cm))

material.description: Water material, a short name from list `water_materials` (e.g. "MI_Water_Quiet") or a path.

preset.description: an effect: bonfire | fire | candle | smoke_column | heavy_smoke | explosion | flamethrower | magic | mist | mud | blood | snow_trails | snow_drift | sand_trails | sandstorm | lava (see list `effects`); or water: lake | pool | sea | sea_wavy | sea_200m | sea_wavy_200m | river | river_whitewater | river_whitewater_inverse | water_tank | tracks | default (or a preset asset path). Lakes, pools and seas look right anywhere (put ground below them, e.g. a terrain basin); the river presets are made to follow a spline over a landscape and look like a sandy bed with streaks on open ground.

resolution.description: Grid cells per side, 256-2048 (higher = finer ripples, more GPU), e.g. 1024.

size_meters.description: Side of the simulated square in metres, e.g. 80 (the preset's own size when omitted).

yaw.description: Turn the whole effect around its vertical axis, degrees (fire and smoke face the camera anyway).

tools.name: fluid.add

returnValue.description: The new simulation. Fails if FluidNinja is not in the project, the preset or material is unknown, or a value is out of range.

surface.description: The water surface it drives (node id); empty for presets that draw on their own plane.

returnValue.title: RuntimeFluidInfo

tools.description:
Places a flow source: it pushes fluid and feeds density into the simulations it is inside (or near). Undoable.
Returns: The source. Fails if FluidNinja is not in the project or the kind is unknown.

kind.description: water_hose | water_hose_mini | jet | vortex | avalanche | bonfire | smoke | smoke_light | burst | burst_radial | radial | linear | turret | cauldron | grid.

rotation.description: Direction it points, [pitch, yaw, roll], e.g. [0, 90, 0]. ([pitch, yaw, roll] (degrees))

tools.name: fluid.add_source

returnValue.description: The source. Fails if FluidNinja is not in the project or the kind is unknown.
returnValue.title: RuntimeFluidPart

tools.description:
Places an ambient particle effect (no simulation): weather and atmosphere around a spot. Undoable.
Returns: The effect. Fails if FluidNinja is not in the project or the kind is unknown.

kind.description: blizzard | sandstorm | rain | rain_translucent | sparks | sparks_burning | magic | plankton | plankton_soft.

tools.name: fluid.ambient

returnValue.description: The effect. Fails if FluidNinja is not in the project or the kind is unknown.
returnValue.title: RuntimeFluidPart

tools.description:
Makes objects float on water: boats, barrels, crates, debris bob at the surface, drift and settle (turns their physics on).
Returns: The floating objects and the water level. Fails if a target has no collision (physics needs it).

buoyancy.description: Lift when fully under water, in multiples of the object's weight (1.2 rides low, 3 rides high).

drag.description: Water drag (0.3 drifts freely, 3 calms quickly).

items.description: Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path

water_level.description: Water surface height (cm); default: the nearest water simulation's surface.

tools.name: fluid.float

returnValue.description: The floating objects and the water level. Fails if a target has no collision (physics needs it).
returnValue.title: RuntimeFluidFloatResult

tools.description:
A simulation's tunable settings and surface look, with current values. Main simulation settings: SimSpeed (how fast it moves; lower = thicker, slower), BrushStrength (how hard things push), GlobalBrushSize, SkeletalMeshBrushSize (characters), PrimitiveObjBrushSize (objects), VehicleBrushSize, BrushHardness (soft 0 .. sharp 1 marks), DensityAccumulation (how fast it fills back in), PersistencyOfFieldAndPointData (how long marks last), VelocityFeedback (how long motion carries on, 0..1), VelocityClamp, PressureFeedback, VeloFromBrushMotion (how much movement drags it along), DensityNoiseAmount and BrushDensityNoise (irregularity).
Returns: Settings and surface parameters. Fails if there is no such simulation.

id.description: The simulation (id from list / add), e.g. "n4".

tools.name: fluid.get_settings

returnValue.description: Settings and surface parameters. Fails if there is no such simulation.

simulation.description: Simulation behaviour, name -> value (the main ones; fluid.set_settings accepts any numeric or on/off setting by name).

surface.description: Surface look: the output materials' parameters, name -> value (numbers, or colours as (R=,G=,B=,A=)).

surface_materials.description: The output materials the surface values belong to.

returnValue.title: RuntimeFluidSettings

tools.description:
Lists the fluid simulations in the level, the presets and the water materials.
Returns: Simulations, presets and materials; `installed` false when the FluidNinja content is missing.
tools.name: fluid.list

returnValue.description: Simulations, presets and materials; `installed` false when the FluidNinja content is missing.

ambient.description: Ambient particle effects fluid.ambient accepts (no simulation needed).

effects.description: Effects fluid.add accepts, "name: what it is" (fire, smoke, mist, mud, snow / sand trails, lava ...).

surface.description: The water surface it drives (node id); empty for presets that draw on their own plane.

installed.description: Whether the FluidNinja LIVE content is in the project (/Game/FluidNinjaLive).

sources.description: Flow sources fluid.add_source accepts (they push and feed nearby simulations).

water_materials.description: Water materials (short names) the `material` argument accepts, e.g. "MI_Water_Quiet".

returnValue.title: RuntimeFluidList

tools.description:
Removes a fluid simulation and its surface. Undoable.
Returns: The list after the removal. Fails if the id is not a fluid simulation.

id.description: The simulation (node id from add or list).

tools.name: fluid.remove

returnValue.description: The list after the removal. Fails if the id is not a fluid simulation.

ambient.description: Ambient particle effects fluid.ambient accepts (no simulation needed).

effects.description: Effects fluid.add accepts, "name: what it is" (fire, smoke, mist, mud, snow / sand trails, lava ...).

surface.description: The water surface it drives (node id); empty for presets that draw on their own plane.

installed.description: Whether the FluidNinja LIVE content is in the project (/Game/FluidNinjaLive).

sources.description: Flow sources fluid.add_source accepts (they push and feed nearby simulations).

water_materials.description: Water materials (short names) the `material` argument accepts, e.g. "MI_Water_Quiet".

returnValue.title: RuntimeFluidList

tools.description:
Tunes a simulation live: behaviour settings and its surface look (see get_settings for names and current values).
Returns: The settings after the change. Fails if there is no such simulation or a name is unknown.

colors.description: Surface material colours by name, as hex, e.g. {"Color": "#4a3222"}.

surface.description: Surface material numbers by name, e.g. {"Roughness": 0.3}.

tools.name: fluid.set_settings

returnValue.description: The settings after the change. Fails if there is no such simulation or a name is unknown.
